params.name: Multiple jumps
params.usage: 0: Allowed; 1-127: Not allowed

params.name: Multiple drops
params.usage: 0: Allowed; 1-127: Not allowed

params.name: Fade time
params.desc: Set fade time, overrides potentiometer. Potentiometer LED starts to blink, indicating that you need to catch the value to get it back into operation.

params.name: Jump time
params.usage: 0: One full cycle; 1: 10 seconds; 2: 20 seconds; 3: 30 seconds; 4: 40 seconds; 5: 50 seconds; 6-127: 60 seconds
params.desc: MENU > Settings > Jump time. Sets the maximum fade time of a Jump.

params.name: Length
params.usage: 0: Do nothing; 1~32: Number of bars
params.desc: PLAY > Length. Sets the number of bars per cycle.

params.name: Jump quantization
params.usage: 0: No quantization; 1: 1/16 note; 2: 1/8 note; 3: 1/4 note; 4: 1/2 note; 5-127: 1 bar
params.desc: PLAY > Quantization, sets the quantization for Jump.
